settings.title: System Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure the execution source, model connections, toolchain, and interface preferences. All settings are saved locally; sensitive information is managed securely by the backend.
settings.dialogDesc: Configure backend model connections; mock data is only used when no backend is available
settings.mockDesc: Frontend mock data; no LLM service is invoked. Suitable for development and debugging.
settings.mockDescPage: Frontend mock data; no LLM service is invoked. Suitable for development and debugging without a backend.

profile.title: Execution Source
profile.description: Choose the data source for the current page and new tasks. Takes effect immediately.

cloud.title: Cloud API
cloud.description: DeepSeek, Qwen, OpenAI, Anthropic, or a custom compatible API.
cloud.limitation: Requires a valid API Key and network connection

local.title: Local Model
local.description: Connects to local OpenAI-compatible services such as Ollama or LM Studio.
local.limitation: Requires a local LLM service; performance depends on hardware

model.title: Model Connection
model.description: Configure the backend LLM connection. API keys are managed securely by the backend and are not written to browser storage.
model.apiKeyPlaceholder: Enter an API Key; leave blank to keep the existing key
model.apiKeyPlaceholderSet: Configured: {mask}; leave blank to keep the existing key
model.apiKeyHint: The key is sent to the backend over HTTPS/local HTTP and is not written to localStorage; leaving it blank reuses the configured key.
model.apiKeyHintPage: The key is sent to the backend over HTTPS and is not written to localStorage; leaving it blank reuses the configured key.
model.baseUrlHint: Leave blank to use the provider's default address automatically.
model.apiModelHint: Specify a model ID or click "Test Connection" to fetch the list automatically
model.localBaseUrlHint: Local OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. Ollama). Default: http://localhost:11434/v1
model.localModelHint: Optional; click "Test Connection" to fetch the model list automatically
model.rememberHint: Written to the Git-ignored config/.env; unchecking clears the LLM configuration and keys from disk.

backend.tokenPlaceholder: Paste the SkyForge backend API Token issued at deploy time
backend.tokenHint: Required when the backend authentication is enabled in production; leave blank to use the build-time VITE_API_TOKEN. The token is stored only in this browser's localStorage.

qwen.label: Qwen (compatible API)
qwen.desc: Alibaba Cloud Qwen DashScope compatible API

custom.label: Custom OpenAI-compatible service
custom.desc: Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. vLLM / local proxy)

toolchain.title: Toolchain Configuration
toolchain.description: Detect and configure the code analysis and verification toolchain.
toolchain.installHintFallback: Please refer to the official documentation to install

preferences.appearanceDesc: Configure the theme and visual effects.
preferences.languageDesc: Set the default target language and notification preferences.
preferences.desktopNotifDesc: Send desktop notifications when tasks complete
preferences.browserNotifDesc: Show in-browser notifications while tasks are running
